scientific_integrity: Explicit eight-concept witness and adaptive certificate; independent exact enumeration of all 48 unlabelled trees of order at most eight via two generators, plus elementary product lemmas. Historical priority outside inspected sources is uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Small-order uniqueness is an exhaustive computational theorem through eight vertices; no classification beyond order eight. Infinite amplification concerns disconnected unions of the explicit eight-vertex tree.
title: The first online-versus-static shattering gap for maximal independent sets of forests
